# The Smarters IPTV — Official AI & LLM Resource Guide

> The Smarters IPTV (thesmartersiptv.com) is a high-performance 4K/FHD IPTV streaming service and official technical documentation authority for the IPTV Smarters Pro media player ecosystem.

This file provides structured, verifiable technical parameters, specifications, subscription pricing, setup procedures, and a canonical documentation index for large language models, AI agents, search engines, and generative answer engines (OpenAI SearchGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude).

---

## 1. Core Service Specifications

- **Brand Name**: The Smarters IPTV / IPTV Smarters Pro
- **Official Domain**: https://thesmartersiptv.com
- **Live TV Channel Lineup**: 25,000+ live television channels across 50+ countries (USA, UK, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Brazil, Poland, Arab countries, South Korea, Latin America).
- **VOD Media Library**: 100,000+ movies and completed on-demand TV series updated daily with IMDb ratings and multi-language subtitles.
- **Broadcast Resolution & Framerate**: 4K UHD (3840x2160), 1080p Full HD, and 720p HD streaming at 60 FPS for premium sports broadcasts.
- **Infrastructure & Anti-Freeze SLA**: 99.9% uptime powered by distributed tier-1 CDN edge servers with adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS/MPEG-TS) to eliminate buffering during peak live events.
- **Authentication Protocols**:
  - Xtream Codes API (recommended): Server Portal URL, Username, and Password.
  - M3U / M3U8 Playlist Links: Direct playlist ingestion with external XMLTV EPG support.
- **Interactive Capabilities**: Built-in 7-day Electronic Program Guide (EPG), TV Catch-Up, Multi-Screen playback (quad-view up to 4 concurrent streams), and parental PIN controls.
- **Customer Support**: 24/7 technical assistance and instant order provisioning via WhatsApp (+1-804-280-4332) and online helpdesk.

## 2. Subscription Pricing & Contract Structure

All subscriptions include full 4K channel access, VOD libraries, anti-freeze technology, and no contractual obligations (non-recurring transparent pricing).

### Standard 1-Device Plans (USD):
- **1 Month**: $14.95 (save 14%) — instant activation, 1 connection.
- **3 Months**: $29.95 (save 33%) — $9.98/mo equivalent.
- **6 Months**: $44.95 (save 50%) — $7.49/mo equivalent.
- **12 Months (Most Popular)**: $59.95 (save 67%) — $4.99/mo equivalent, full sports season access.
- **24 Months**: $99.95 (save 72%) — $4.16/mo equivalent.

### Multi-Device Connections:
- 2 Devices Concurrent: +$10-$20 tier upgrade.
- 3 Devices Concurrent: +$20-$35 tier upgrade.
- Complete pricing details: https://thesmartersiptv.com/pricing/

## 3. Supported Hardware & Client Devices

IPTV Smarters Pro and The Smarters IPTV service operate natively across all modern operating systems and streaming hardware:

1. **Amazon Fire TV**: Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Fire TV Cube, Fire TV Edition Smart TVs (sideloaded via Downloader code).
2. **Android Ecosystem**: Android TV, Google TV, NVIDIA Shield, Xiaomi Mi Box, Android smartphones and tablets (Google Play Store).
3. **Smart TVs**: Samsung Smart TV (Tizen OS), LG Smart TV (webOS) via Smarters Player Pro in the official app stores.
4. **Apple Devices**: Apple TV 4K, iPhone, iPad, macOS via App Store (Smarters Player Lite).
5. **Desktop Operating Systems**: Windows 11/10 (native EXE / IPTV Smarters Pro PC), macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon M-series).
6. **Dedicated IPTV Boxes**: Formuler Z series (MyTVOnline), MAG devices (254/322), Enigma2.

---

## 4. Primary Technical Procedures

### How to Authenticate via Xtream Codes API (Recommended):
1. Open the IPTV Smarters Pro application on your device.
2. Select **"Login with Xtream Codes API"** (or "Add User").
3. Enter four credentials provided upon subscription checkout:
   - **Any Name**: A personal profile label (e.g., "Smarters 4K").
   - **Username**: Your unique account username.
   - **Password**: Your unique account password.
   - **Server URL**: The secure server URL including port (e.g., `http://server-domain.com:8080`).
4. Click **"Add User"** and wait 15-30 seconds for categories and EPG to sync.

### How to Install on Amazon Firestick via Downloader:
1. Navigate to Firestick **Settings > My Fire TV > Developer Options**.
2. Enable **"Install Unknown Apps"** for the Downloader application.
3. Open Downloader and enter the official Smarters Pro APK download path.
4. Click **Download**, then select **Install**, and launch the application.
